gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads quietly modern, its curves left open at the ends and its middle line set high. Tilt Neon is the loud one here, a tube of constant-width stroke with a splayed c, while the body simply keeps out of its way.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Commanding up top, Tilt Neon draws every line at an unvarying thickness, like glowing tube. Noto Sans Buhid follows with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, a modern, plain sans voice that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham reads clean and modern, with tall rounded lowercase forms and generously open entries. Tilt Neon is stencil-flat and bold above it, so the two feel like a loud sign hung over a quiet conversation.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian:
Tilt Neon presses its strokes in like twine, bold and flat.

Noto Sans Chorasmian sits below with curves that stop short of closing, so the heavy, commanding heading and the lighter plain sans body share the page without crowding each other.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-coptic: A splayed c and a stroke that never changes width make Tilt Neon unmistakable. Noto Sans Coptic then fills the lines with a dominant middle zone and open, uncrowded mouths, a plain sans texture that gives the heading room to be loud.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Tilt Neon draws every stroke at one weight, a bold tube with a large x-height and short ascenders, and a splayed c terminal. Its best quality is sheer commanding presence.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-duployan:
Tilt Neon draws like a plotter pen, bold and commanding.

Noto Sans Duployan answers with wide-mouthed a and oversized e counters, and that generous, plain sans openness is the pair's strongest quality against such a tightly uniform heading line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Tilt Neon's vertical and horizontal strokes carry identical weight, giving it a bold, commanding tube look. Noto Sans Elbasan has large lowercase forms and open terminals that never pinch, so a modest size is enough for it beside the heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Tilt Neon's splayed c and steady drafting-pen line make it bold and commanding, with a large x-height under short ascenders. Noto Sans Elymaic stays open throughout, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Big, bold, and tubular, Tilt Neon traces a single-width trail like a rolling-ball pen. And Noto Sans Gothic answers with lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads, round forms like open parentheses in a plain sans.
